Treatment summary
Patient presented following a motor vehicle collision in which their vehicle was struck on the driver side while turning left. The
reported mechanism is consistent with the type and force of the impact, and the resulting wrist fracture is clearly confirmed on
imaging and on examination. The patient's history includes a minor strain to the same region several years ago, which resolved
completely without residual limitation. Over the course of approximately 20 office visits, care followed a typical progression of
immobilization, supervised therapy, and graded return to activity. Visit frequency decreased steadily as function improved, and
the patient was discharged from active treatment once goals were met. Billing records refelct single, non-duplicated charges for
each service rendered. Follow-up is recommended only if new symptoms arise.

  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
